definitions.explanation: A barrier made of plants, bamboo, or other materials used to separate or enclose a property. Can be living (plants) or constructed.
Metaphorically, a barrier or division between people, groups, or concepts.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{垣根|かきね}を{剪定|せんてい}した。
examples.english: I trimmed the hedge in the garden.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}との{垣根|かきね}が{低|ひく}すぎる。
examples.english: The fence between us and the neighbors is too low.

examples.japanese: {国|くに}と{国|くに}の{垣根|かきね}を{越|こ}えて{協力|きょうりょく}する。

notes:
TYPES OF HEDGES/FENCES:
・{生|い}け{垣|がき} (living hedge made of plants)
・{竹垣|たけがき} (bamboo fence)
・{板垣|いたがき} (wooden board fence)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
・{垣根|かきね}を{取|と}り{払|はら}う (to remove barriers)
・{垣根|かきね}を{越|こ}える (to cross boundaries)
・{垣根|かきね}を{設|もう}ける (to set up barriers)
・{垣根|かきね}が{低|ひく}い (approachable, accessible - lit. 'low fence')

CULTURE: Traditional Japanese gardens often feature carefully maintained hedges and fences as aesthetic elements.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{塀|へい} (wall, fence - solid structure)
・フェンス (fence - metal/wire)
・{柵|さく} (fence, railing)
